title: asclepias palustris
intro: Asclepias palustris, commonly known as Marsh Milkweed, is a perennial plant species within the Asclepiadaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Asclepias palustris are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include cardenolides, which have shown promise in reducing inflammation and improving wound healing.
